items: [bloomberg] epic games has delayed an unannounced shooter game featuring star wars & marvel characters. developers on the game have now been told to only use ai to write the code — “no more hand-written code”; all art for the game would be “generated with full ai workflows"
microsoft has created a new xbox labs group to experiment with decompiling and recompiling games after the trend of the ai-powered decompiling of games blew up
rimworld switches from unity to their own new waylith game engine. game is now 2-4x faster. somehow, mods all still work
